free_tier.stated: Hands-on RNGD evaluation exists and is gated by a sales form: the request page offers 'BARE METAL - Access dedicated RNGD hardware in a nearby data center to run your workloads' and 'API ENDPOINT - Connect your applications to RNGD-hosted models through APIs provided by our cloud partners', under the heading 'Start testing today', with the form requiring 'First name', 'Last name' and 'Business email' and a 'Talk to sales' link. No price, no trial duration, no allocation size and no self-serve signup is published. The vendor's own description of the programme is that it 'provides structured pathways for customers and partners to evaluate, integrate, qualify, and deploy Furiosa accelerators'.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: The API endpoint route chains with any OpenAI-compatible client once a partner host is chosen, which is the cheapest way to benchmark a RNGD endpoint. It does not chain into free capacity: every route ends in a sales contact or a marketplace subscription.

limits.value: the gate is a business email and a sales conversation before any hardware is allocated; nothing about quota binds earlier because no quota is published.
